name: voice-harness
description: Talk with a coding agent while it steers the editor and shows figures inline.

voiceHarness.nodePath.description: Absolute path to the node binary. Empty: resolve via a login shell.

voiceHarness.claudePath.description: Absolute path to the claude CLI. Empty: resolve via a login shell.

voiceHarness.speakReplies.description: Speak Claude's replies aloud when the panel opens.

voiceHarness.echoCancellation.description: Use macOS voice processing to cancel the speech echo, for use without headphones. Takes effect when the panel is reopened.

voiceHarness.modelsDirectory.description: Folder for the speech models (downloaded on first use). Empty: ~/Library/Application Support/voice-harness/models.

voiceHarness.autoInterrupt.description: Pause Claude's speech automatically when you start talking over it. Off: speech stops only when you press Talk or Stop. Takes effect when the panel is reopened.
